note.en: A skeleton of Korean history, weighted towards what she will actually stand in front of in Seoul.
note.zh: 一份韓國歷史的骨架，偏重於她在首爾會親眼看到的那些地方。

description.en: The first Korean kingdom. Tradition places its founding in 2333 BCE under Dangun, a figure of myth rather than record. It fell to Han China in 108 BCE.
description.zh: 朝鮮半島上的第一個國家。傳說由檀君於西元前 2333 年建立，這位開國者屬於神話而非信史。西元前 108 年亡於漢朝。

description.en: Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla divided the peninsula for seven centuries, competing in war, craft and Buddhism. Much of what fills the National Museum comes from these three.
description.zh: 高句麗、百濟、新羅三分半島七百年，在戰爭、工藝與佛教上彼此競逐。國立中央博物館裡的許多藏品都出自這三國。

description.en: Silla absorbed its rivals and ruled a single kingdom for nearly three centuries. Buddhism became the state religion — Bongeunsa was founded in 794, in this period.
description.zh: 新羅併吞對手，統一治理近三個世紀。佛教成為國教 —— 奉恩寺便創建於此時期的 794 年。

description.en: The dynasty that gave the country its English name. Goryeo produced celadon of a green no one has quite matched since, and carved the Tripitaka Koreana onto more than 80,000 wooden blocks.
description.zh: 「Korea」這個名字便源自高麗。高麗燒出的青瓷，那種綠色後世再難企及；並將八萬多塊木板刻成《高麗大藏經》。

description.en: Five centuries under one family — one of the longest-lived dynasties anywhere. Confucian in law and manners, and the Korea that the palaces, the hanok and the court dress all belong to.
description.zh: 同一個王室統治五百餘年，是世界上最長壽的王朝之一。以儒家治國、規範禮俗 —— 宮殿、韓屋與宮廷服飾，都屬於這個朝鮮。

description.en: King Taejo moved the capital to Hanyang — mountains at its back, the Han River in front. It has been the capital ever since, and the city she is walking through is the one he laid out.
description.zh: 太祖將國都遷至漢陽 —— 背倚群山，前臨漢江。此後它一直是首都；她此刻走過的城市，正是當年規劃出來的那一座。

description.en: The main royal palace, its name meaning "greatly blessed by Heaven." Stop 1 of Day 1.
description.zh: 王朝正宮，宮名意為「景命之福」。第一天的第 1 站。

description.en: King Sejong published an alphabet designed so that ordinary people could learn it in a morning — the letter shapes echo the mouth making the sound. Scholars who preferred Chinese characters were appalled.
description.zh: 世宗頒行一套文字，設計得讓平民一個早上就能學會 —— 字形模擬發音時口舌的形狀。當時偏好漢字的士大夫大為震怒。

description.en: Japanese invasions devastated the peninsula for six years. Gyeongbokgung burned and lay in ruins for nearly 270 years. Admiral Yi Sun-sin's turtle ships broke the invasion at sea.
description.zh: 日本入侵，半島飽受蹂躪達六年之久。景福宮焚毀，此後荒廢近 270 年。李舜臣將軍的龜船在海上擊潰了侵略軍。

description.en: The regent Heungseon Daewongun rebuilt the palace to restore the dynasty's authority. It very nearly bankrupted the treasury.
description.zh: 興宣大院君下令重建王宮，以重振王室威權。工程幾乎拖垮國庫。

description.en: King Gojong declared himself emperor, asserting equality with China and Japan as the powers closed in. It lasted thirteen years.
description.zh: 高宗稱帝，在列強環伺之際宣示與中日平起平坐。這個帝國只維持了十三年。

description.en: Thirty-five years of annexation. The Korean language was suppressed in schools, palace buildings were demolished, and Ikseon-dong's affordable hanok were built as a quiet act of resistance.
description.zh: 三十五年的併吞歲月。學校裡禁用韓語，宮殿建築遭到拆毀；益善洞的平價韓屋，正是在此時作為一種無聲的抵抗而興建。

description.en: Japan surrendered and Korea was free — then immediately divided at the 38th parallel by the Soviet Union and the United States. The date is still a national holiday.
description.zh: 日本投降，朝鮮光復 —— 但隨即被蘇聯與美國以三十八度線分割。這一天至今仍是國定假日。

description.en: Seoul changed hands four times and was left in ruins. The war ended in an armistice, not a peace treaty — technically it has never formally ended.
description.zh: 首爾四度易手，最終成為廢墟。這場戰爭以停戰協定收場，而非和平條約 —— 嚴格說來，它從未正式結束。

title.en: The Miracle on the Han River

description.en: One of the poorest countries on earth became one of the richest inside a single lifetime. Gangnam was farmland when this began; by the end it was the most expensive land in Korea.
description.zh: 一個世上最貧窮的國家，在一代人的時間裡躋身最富裕之列。這一切開始時，江南還是農田；結束時，它已是韓國地價最高的地方。

description.en: Weeks of nationwide protest forced the military government to concede direct presidential elections. Myeongdong Cathedral sheltered the protesters — police would not enter church grounds.
description.zh: 全國性的抗爭持續數週，迫使軍政府讓步、實行總統直選。明洞聖堂庇護了示威者 —— 警方不願踏入教堂範圍。

description.en: The Games that introduced the country to the world, a year after it became a democracy. Much of modern Seoul was built to be seen during them.
description.zh: 在民主化的隔年，這場奧運將韓國介紹給全世界。現代首爾有很大一部分，就是為了在那時被看見而建起來的。

description.en: A song satirising the pretensions of the district became the first video to reach a billion views, and taught the world a Korean place name. Stop 15 is that district.
description.zh: 一首調侃江南浮誇作派的歌曲，成為史上第一支破十億觀看的影片，也讓全世界記住了一個韓國地名。第 15 站就是那個江南。
